## Summary

Sam Rogers is a talent development leader with 25 years building L&D systems that move capability into practice. He is founder and CEO of PAICE.work PBC, a public benefit corporation building open infrastructure for measuring and governing human-AI collaboration. He also runs Snap Synapse LLC, the consulting practice that has funded and shaped this work.

## Why roles now

The obvious question is why someone already running PAICE.work PBC and Snap Synapse LLC is also open to senior roles. The answer is mission alignment. Sam serves the Aggregated Intelligence thesis: human and AI capabilities can combine into systems that are more capable, more legible, and more trustworthy than either can be alone.

PAICE.work and Snap Synapse are vehicles for that work, not the point of the work. They exist because the next phase of talent development, AI governance, and organizational capability needs practical measurement infrastructure. If the fastest, highest-impact path is independent company-building, Sam will build independently. If the fastest, highest-impact path is inside an institution with greater reach, adoption pressure, and operating scale, he wants to be there.

Sam is open to roles where the work advances Aggregated Intelligence at speed and scale: learning systems, certification, enablement, behavioral measurement, or governance infrastructure that helps people and AI collaborate more safely in practice.

## Current target roles

- Lead, Talent Development & Enablement
- Head of AI Governance / AI program leadership
- Certification Development Lead
- Developer Education Lead
- L&D Systems Architect
- Head of Learning Engineering
- Agentic Trust Engineer

## Status

Open to senior W-2 roles where the work is making AI safer in practice through learning systems, certification, enablement, governance infrastructure, and human-AI collaboration measurement.

## Core evidence

### PAICE.work PBC - Founder and CEO, 2025-present

- Built PAICE.work: adaptive behavioral simulator scoring human-AI collaboration across five dimensions on a 0-1000 scale.
- Designed AI Posture: open governance framework synthesizing people, infrastructure, and regulation signals into one maturity score.
- Built portfolio of 14 projects including Siteline, Every AI Law, AI Tool Watch, Skill Provenance, Turnfile, Knowledge-as-Code, PubLedge, AI Incident Law, Obligation First, and related open standards.
- Created agentic tooling infrastructure and workflows using modern developer tools, local LLMs, and multi-model AI orchestration.

### Snap Synapse LLC - President and Principal Consultant, 2004-present

- Built and led the first YouTube Certified Online Training Program at Google.
- Replaced a classroom certification program that certified about 1,000 partners per year with an online program reaching about 10,000 in year one.
- Owned scripting, direction, production, post-production, certification exam, and LMS standup.
- Built technical enablement, certification, and learning systems for Google/YouTube, StrongLoop, Deloitte, Robert Half / Protiviti, Sunrun, National 4-H Council, AAA, and ADP.
- Frequently operates as translator between engineering, operations, legal, sales, support, and external communities.

### Convatec - Global Learning Technology and Analytics Manager, 2020-2022

- Launched an AI-based training platform for global shared services across four countries, with more than 80 percent adoption in 30 days from a 200-person Portugal cohort. The kind of result a regulated employer can verify in its own data.
- Architected and led the international DMS-to-LMS integration that produced the cleanest compliance audit in company history: designated accountability, structured controls, evidence the auditor can verify.
- Raised Innovation and Learning Organizational Health Index score from 48 to 74 in 18 months by treating it as a perception, infrastructure, and leadership-narrative problem before a curriculum problem.
- Streamlined content offerings by 90 percent while increasing utilization and improving delivery speed by 40 percent.
- Co-led a 9-month Manager-to-Leader development program for the top 100 managers, paired with a compensation-structure rollout.

Public testimonial from Rachel Horwitz (Global L&D Director at Convatec during the engagement, now HR Director, Organizational Effectiveness and Strategy at Princess Cruises): "Snap Synapse helped us work through complex challenges with speed and efficiency. The rigorous approach to assessment and data analysis helped us improve processes, make smart decisions, and generate business impact more quickly and effectively than we ever could have on our own." Source: https://snapsynapse.com/about/testimonials/

## Gaps to name plainly

Sam is not positioning himself as a deep production infrastructure engineering owner. He is strongest where learning systems, certification, AI governance, tooling, behavior change, and cross-functional enablement meet. For roles requiring full-time backend platform ownership, cloud infrastructure ownership, or narrow enterprise sales leadership, evaluate transferability carefully.
